# Robust regression wrapper

<small>Source: [`R/fitRobust.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/fitRobust.R) · Help: `?fitRobust`</small>

Provides a simple interface to `MASS::rlm` for robust estimation.

## Usage

```r
fitRobust(model, data = NULL, ...)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   A fitted model of class `lm` or a formula.

`data`
:   Optional data frame if `model` is a formula.

`...`
:   Additional arguments passed to `MASS::rlm`.

## Value

An object of class `rlm`.

## Examples

```r
data(mtcars)
m <- fitRobust(mpg ~ wt + qsec, mtcars)
summary(m)
```
